audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer treated this as a symmetric ball-placement mirror ('the cleanest control mirror in the game'). The content layer already had it right: the danger is her roam, not the lane.
audit.why: Worked Ground clears the wave fast and Weaver's Wall reaches 2500/4500/6500 units, so she leaves; the lane itself is even at 49.55%.
audit.corrected: tldr, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave and ahead now frame it as a roam race you match by crashing first.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' — the latter is a magnitude with no source, and level 6 is her roam unlock.
audit.why: Weaver's Wall is 180s at rank 1 and is a map tool, not a lane tool; your Shockwave is 110s and is a fight tool.
audit.corrected: Spike line rewritten: Lost Chapter for mana, level 6 for her Wall roams, Luden's for matching her shove speed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Unraveled Earth only stuns 'if enemies dash through it or are knocked through it', and Seismic Shove is the knock that does it. The page just said 'sidestep it and the burst whiffs'. breakdown.cooldowns also had no cooldown number in it.
audit.why: The stun is conditional on being displaced through the field — a player who knows that stands outside the mines before she can throw them there.
audit.corrected: tradeBad, enemyWin, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now state the W-throws-you-into-E-mines chain with Seismic Shove 14s->8s, Unraveled Earth 14s flat and Weaver's Wall 180s at rank 1.
sources: brief enemyKit E text 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them'
brief enemyKit W text and cd 14/12.5/11/9.5/8

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early implied you win early on auto-weaving alone, with no reason.
audit.why: The concrete early edge is mana: Threaded Volley costs 55-75 against Command: Attack's flat 35 on the same 7/6/5/4/3 cooldown.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now names the cost gap. Note: her Q text says she moves freely while casting, so no 'stands still to cast' claim was written.
sources: brief enemyKit Q cost 55/60/65/70/75, text 'moving freely as she casts'

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Taliyah 'he/his' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, both dosFull titles, dontsFull[1].d and report[9].t.
audit.corrected: All affected fields rewritten with female pronouns.
